detailed_assessment.religious_connection: Bath with immediate reported pain/appetite change; subsequent walking recovery and radiological remodeling.
detailed_assessment.actual_documentation: Published radiograph reproductions dated1August1962 and23August1963 inspected. Histology and other films described, not independently examined here.
open_conflicts: Garner reports two-month chemotherapy trial; Neilan and later report-derived summaries say none. Original treatment chart needed.
Garner publishes1963 post-pilgrimage film; Neilan calls1964 first films.
CMIL1971/1972 decision chronology differs between summaries.
detailed_assessment.structural_vs_symptomatic: Symptomatic improvement was abrupt; entire pelvis was not documented regenerating instantly on film.
detailed_assessment.counterevidence: Dissing1978 documents an adult malignant pelvic-tumor regression with radiographs and histology, without antitumor treatment, over a much longer course. It is a relevant comparator, not a complete Micheli explanation.
detailed_assessment.assessment: Serious structural-recovery candidate; treatment discrepancy unresolved; no complete causal adjudication.

detailed_assessment.religious_connection: August1976 pilgrimage and baths in Dowling; September lesion progression; December home recovery with continuing Marian prayer and Lourdes water.
detailed_assessment.actual_documentation: CMIL physician describes serial radiographs and biopsy reviews by Cordaro,Payan,Nezelof,Mazabraud/Curie colleagues. Raw slides and paired films not retrieved.
detailed_assessment.diagnosis: Malignancy retained; neuroblastoma metastasis versus Ewing sarcoma debated.
detailed_assessment.treatment: Amputation and cobalt irradiation proposed but declined; no antitumor treatment in Dowling narrative.
detailed_assessment.structural_vs_symptomatic: Delayed progressive recovery and bone repair with residual knee angulation; not an instant bath-side disappearance.
open_conflicts: Exact subtype and current natural-history comparison require pathology.
Later summaries differ on age and July/August pilgrimage month.
next_records: Original biopsy and independent pathology review
detailed_assessment.assessment: Important recovery candidate; delayed onset weakens strict immediate bath-timing inference without erasing continued water/prayer association.

detailed_assessment.religious_connection: Lourdes baths and Eucharistic procession, with examinations reported before and after24–27July1923.
detailed_assessment.actual_documentation: 1926 published report reproduces examination certificates,1924 GP follow-up and1926 later examination. New independent military pension-card reproduction saved.
detailed_assessment.before: 24July examination attributed to Azurdia,Finn,Marley. Certificate issued subsequently; original1923 clinical sheet not acquired.
detailed_assessment.after: 25July walking possible but difficult;27July improved walking,arm use,sensation and smaller skull opening.1926 residual claw hand/forearm difference retained.
detailed_assessment.structural_vs_functional: Nerve regeneration inferred by Vallet, not directly imaged or microscopically observed. Skull closure assessed clinically; no paired skull radiographs retrieved.
detailed_assessment.new_evidence: Pension card identifies RNR service,address and gunshot chest injury; birth year1882 differs from article1883. WFA reports100%disability. Card does not prove every operative detail or post-cure official medical reassessment.
next_records: Ministry of Pensions medical-board records and correspondence
detailed_assessment.assessment: Substantive historical medical recovery record; no adequate complete ordinary cause demonstrated here, but key original neurological files still absent.
